statistics.missingPolicy: An empty value remains null; published zero remains zero. Each metric keeps the immediately following Symbols column. Geographic footnote IDs are retained. Census counts are not population estimates.

topology.validation: Closed finite rings, opposite outer/hole winding, bounding-box segment sweep with exact near-collinear orientation, nonadjacent self-cross/touch/overlap, outer-hole and hole-hole intersection, hole containment and hole nesting; whole-CMA MultiPolygon boundaries and filled-region containment also checked in native EPSG:3347 and after delivery EPSG:4326 projection/rounding.

deliveryCoordinatePrecision.method: All source vertices, order, closure and holes are retained. Only final EPSG:4326 number precision is reduced; single-polygon and global shared-boundary topology are revalidated after rounding.

topology.acceptance: No new proper crossings, overlaps or hole errors are accepted, including between separate polygons of a CMA and across neighboring CMAs. The two isolated nonadjacent endpoint-contact locations (8 segment pairs) in the official Regina outer ring and the original shared boundaries of Ottawa–Gatineau provincial pieces and neighboring CMAs are preserved without splitting, union or repair. Strict OGC validity is not claimed for those original source contacts/shared segments.

geometry.method: Every original polygon ring and hole is retained. Douglas–Peucker candidates use only official source vertices in original metres, retrying the whole polygon at 250 / 125 / 62.5 / 31.25 / 15.625 m; native and delivery ring topology and whole-CMA and cross-CMA non-overlap must pass. Both polygons involved in a new MultiPolygon defect are retried at lower tolerances. Failed candidates fall back to every original polygon vertex without repair. Original shared segments require the complete original polygons on both sides to be preserved. Inverse ellipsoidal Lambert projection; accepted simplified delivery coordinates use 7 decimal places; original fallback retains every source vertex at 9 decimal places with verified rounding error below 0.08 mm and unchanged topology. no area/density estimation. Ottawa–Gatineau province pieces are combined as one CMA. Symbol anchors are interior geometric display anchors, not city halls, population centroids or individual locations.
